reports.title: OpenZeppelin Audit

reports.title: Open Zeppelin v2.0 Security Audit
reports.description: Level K reviewed all smart contracts in the OpenZeppelin library's contracts directory at commit dac5bccf to prepare the OpenZeppelin v2.0 release. The report records fix PRs for each finding, including the removal of BreakInvariantBounty after a Critical frontrunning issue.

The report does not name a re-reviewed commit.

reports.title: Formal Verification of OpenZeppelin (March - April 2022)
reports.description: Certora formal verification (March 2 to April 6, 2022) of OpenZeppelin governance-related contracts (ERC20Votes, ERC20FlashMint, ERC20Wrapper, TimelockController, draft-ERC721Votes, Votes, AccessControl, ERC1155) against CVL specifications written by Certora, complemented by a manual review of the same contracts. Guarantees are limited to the specified properties; the report lists two Medium, one Low and three Informational issues and no Critical/High findings.

versions.coverage: Certora Prover verification of one specified flashLoan burn-accounting property (loops unrolled once) plus a manual review by the Certora team; guarantees limited to the specified rule.

Certora Prover verification of specified invariants and method specs for depositFor, withdrawTo and _recover (supply/balance correlation with the underlying token; loops unrolled once) plus a manual review; guarantees limited to the specified rules.

Certora Prover verification of specified operation-state, state-transition, access (proposer-only scheduling), min-delay and cooldown properties (loops unrolled three times) plus a manual review; guarantees limited to the specified rules.

Certora Prover verification of specified checkpoint, vote-solvency, delegation and mint/burn properties on a harnessed copy (delegateBySig removed, _moveVotingPower rewritten without function pointers, checkpoints capped at one million) plus a manual review; guarantees limited to the specified rules.

Certora Prover verification of four specified properties on grantRole/revokeRole (onlyRole revert propagation and no effect on other accounts; loops unrolled once) plus a manual review; guarantees limited to the specified rules.

Certora Prover verification of specified approval, balance, transfer, mint and burn properties (loops unrolled three times, batch arrays assumed length 3, balanceOfBatch not verified due to tool limitations) plus a manual review; guarantees limited to the specified rules.

reports.title: Formal Verification of OpenZeppelin (May - June 2022)
reports.description: Certora formal verification (May 9 - June 10, 2022) of OpenZeppelin's Initializable, GovernorPreventLateQuorum and ERC1155 Burnable/Pausable/Supply extensions at commit 109778c, proving CVL rules written by Certora and OpenZeppelin. It also documents three issues found by the prover, including a High-severity quorum-update bug in GovernorVotesQuorumFraction, and bug-injection tests of the specifications.

versions.coverage: Certora formal verification of 13 CVL rules/invariants on the initializer/reinitializer state machine, run on two harnesses (flat and multi-inheriting) with storage visibility munged; coverage is limited to the specified properties.

Certora formal verification of 11 CVL rules/invariants on deadline extension and quorum behaviour via a harness inheriting all non-Compound Governor contracts, with _execute stubbed and visibility munged; coverage is limited to the specified properties.

Not separately specified; exercised only indirectly through the GovernorPreventLateQuorum harness, where the prover found that updateQuorumNumerator() changes quorumReached() for past proposals (High), which is not fixed at this commit.
finding_ids: Calling updateQuorumNumerator() can change the output of quorumReached() for previous proposals, leading to unexpected outcomes.
